Prevention: Provide conditions for growing healthy plants such as good soils and adequate water supply.
Avoid application of high doses of nitrogen fertiliser.
Mixed cropping systems by interplanting tomatoes with capsicum or cucumber.
Fields sanitation by removing plant debris.
Monitoring: Yellow sticky traps can be used to monitor the presence of whiteflies for timing of interventions.
For early detection, inspect for adults and eggs.
Direct Control: Neem-based pesticides and add 0.1 to 0.5% of soft soap.
To use, place 1 to 4 yellow sticky cards per 300 square metre field area.
Replace traps at least once a week.
If population is low, spray with soap and water to control whiteflies.
